description:
Generates towns normally, then prunes them into a few clusters on the first tick of a new game, leaving dense groups of towns separated by empty countryside.

Terrain, rivers and industries are untouched - only towns are removed. A few isolated towns are kept and scaled down so they read as outlying hamlets.

The mod only needs to be active when the game starts. Afterwards it does nothing and can safely be removed from the savegame. Raise the game's Town Density to compensate for the towns that get pruned.
name: Town Redistribution
summary: Prunes generated towns into clusters, leaving empty countryside between them.
